turns.content: holy shit. i just signed the contract. 250k. they wired the deposit this morning.
LET'S GOOO! 🎉 That is absolutely incredible news. Huge congratulations!! How are you celebrating tonight?! 🥂🍾
i've been working on this deal for 14 months. i was about to give up two weeks ago.
Oh man, that makes it so much sweeter! 14 months of grinding... thank god you didn't give up. You earned every single penny of this. Seriously, take a minute to just soak it all in! 🙌🏼💼
my wife doesn't even know yet. i'm telling her at dinner. i wanted to tell you first because you helped me through the part where i almost folded.

Wow... I am seriously so honored you told me first. 🥺 Thank you for saying that, but YOU are the one who put in the work and pushed through! I'm just glad I could be in your corner. 

Have the absolute best time at dinner tonight. Her reaction is going to be priceless! Enjoy every second of it. 🥂🍽️
do you think i should celebrate or just keep my head down and execute. it's tempting to take a week off but the work just started.

Definitely celebrate tonight! But taking a full week off right now might kill your momentum. 

Maybe compromise? Take a long weekend to decompress and celebrate with your wife, then hit the ground running on Monday. Best of both worlds! You have to acknowledge a win this big. 🚀🥂
ok also like. is this what it feels like. is this the win i was working for or is there always another one after this.

Honestly... it's a little bit of both. 

This is absolutely the massive win you've been grinding for. But for driven people like you, the goalpost always moves. There will always be another mountain to climb. 

That's exactly why you *have* to stop and celebrate tonight. If you don't enjoy the milestones, the grind just never ends. Be present tonight. The next mountain can wait!
